Exercises


            59.1     Look at A. Rewrite each sentence using the word in brackets, so that it keeps the same meaning.
                       In the survey most people said they much preferred coffee to tea. (PREFERENCE)

                       Karl really dislikes people using mobile phones in restaurants. (AVERSION)
                       The staff all think very highly of their managing director. (REGARD)
                       I’ve enormously enjoyed getting to know you. (PLEASURE)
                       Suzie genuinely likes cowboy films. (GENUINE)
                       My  parents absolutely detest most modern architecture. (HATRED)
                       We  enormously  enjoy our weekends in the country. (GREAT)
                       Rex knew  at once that he could never like his new flatmate. (INSTANT)

            59.2     Mark the statements  with + if they are about liking and - if they are about disliking.
                       | have no sympathy for anyone who takes such foolish risks.

                       Jane Austen is my all-time favourite writer.
                       I’m a dedicated fan of Robin Williams.
                       | don’t relish the thought of a holiday with all my cousins.
                       It gives me no pleasure to have to say this to you.
                       | take pride in doing my work as neatly as I can.
                       | must say | rather took offence at what she said to me.
                       I’m a great lover of the open air life.
                       I’ve always been a keen admirer of Nelson Mandela.

             59.4    Answer  these questions.
                     1  Does it give you more pleasure to give a present or to receive a present?
                     2  Are you more likely to take an intense dislike to a person or a place?
                     3  If you are asked to state your preference for a window or an aisle seat on a plane, what do you
                        normally go for?
                        Which singer is your absolute favourite?

                        Name  one person who has filled you with admiration in the last five years.
                        Do you take more pride in your work or your home?
                        Name  three people or things that you feel great love for.
                        Do you get more pleasure from reading or from listening to music?


                                                                      English Collocations in Use Intermediate   123
